test_xs_basic_row_selection: test the DataFrame.xs method to select a row by index label and return a Series
test_xs_column_selection: test the DataFrame.xs method with axis=1 to select a column by label and return a Series
test_xs_multiindex_level: test the DataFrame.xs method with MultiIndex to select rows by a named level key
test_xs_multiindex_multiple_levels: test the DataFrame.xs method with multiple level keys to select rows from a four-level MultiIndex
test_xs_drop_level_false: test the DataFrame.xs method with drop_level=False to keep the matched level in the result index
